locations: Freetown (three hillside houses; neighbourhood not named)

evidence: At least four people were killed and scores injured following torrential rains in Sierra Leone's capital on Wednesday (Reuters); later summaries: 14,000 people affected and 10 reported dead.

locations: Regent | Sugar Loaf | Babadorie River Valley | Kamayama | Malama | Juba | Juba Bridge | Kaningo | Lumley | Culvert | Dwazark | Mountain Cut | George Brook | Gbangbayilla | Wellington
